CustomField.description: Age of the case (in days) since e.g. it was first identified by ANZ.
CustomField.formula: IF(RecordType.DeveloperName='Systemic_Issue', IF(TEXT(Status)='Closed', DATEVALUE(ClosedDate) - SI_First_Identified_Date__c, TODAY() - SI_First_Identified_Date__c), IF(OR(RecordType.DeveloperName='Customer_Complaint', RecordType.DeveloperName='Non_Customer_Complaint'), IF(OR (TEXT(Status)='Closed',TEXT(Status)='Withdrawn'), DATEVALUE(ClosedDate) -DATEVALUE(IDR_Date_Received__c),TODAY() - DATEVALUE(IDR_Date_Received__c)), NULL))
CustomField.label: Age in days
